1.t: By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence.

2.t: By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers).

3.t: And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits).

4.t: And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses).

5.t: And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).

6.t: On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die).

7.t: The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected).

8.t: (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.

10.t: They say: "Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life?

12.t: They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"

13.t: But it will be only a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)], (See Verse 37:19).

14.t: When behold, they find themselves on the surface of the earth alive after their death,

15.t: Has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)?

16.t: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tûwâ,

17.t: Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief).

18.t: And say to him: "Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)?"

19.t: "And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?"

20.t: Then [Mûsâ (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).

22.t: Then he turned his back, striving (against Allâh).

23.t: Then he gathered (his people) and cried aloud,

24.t: Saying: "I am your lord, most high."

25.t: So Allâh, seized him with punishment for his last

25.fn: Last i.e. his saying: "I am your lord, most high" (See Verse 79:24)
First i.e. his saying, "O chiefs! I know not that you have a god other than I" (See Verse 28:38)

26.t: Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allâh.

27.t: Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed?

28.t: He raised its height, and has perfected it.

29.t: Its night He covers with darkness and its forenoon He brings out (with light)

30.t: And after that He spread the earth,

31.t: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture.

32.t: And the mountains He has fixed firmly,

33.t: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

34.t: But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) -

35.t: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for.

36.t: And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees.

37.t: Then for him who transgressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allâh).

38.t: And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),

39.t: Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;

40.t: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts.

41.t: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.

42.t: They ask you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about the Hour - when will be its appointed time?

43.t: You have no knowledge to say anything about it.

44.t: To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?

45.t: You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are only a warner for those who fear it,

46.t: The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.
